description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Merge commit of PDP-Connect/data-connect PR #34 ('rebuild rejected terminal commits'), confirmed an ancestor of main as of 2026-08-31 via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`. Discovered stale: pdpp's own committed vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz (see pdpp's vendor/README.md provenance commits d8470bcfd5/ceb6ced321) was packed from this commit, not from the prior 9155e57 pin here — the tarball-digest drift check (job c) failed against 9155e57 and passes against this SHA (verified locally: fresh repack of pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz from this commit is byte-identical to pdpp's committed copy, sha256 39a94ba1...). This repo's own vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz and vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz were re-packed from this SHA in the same change that moved this pin (see packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/SHA256SUMS). Supersedes the prior 9155e57ae4 pin (PR #30, 2026-08-20). Source of truth for drift jobs (a) collector-definitions snapshot, (b) vendored connector sources, (c) tarball digests.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp PR #238 (`waspflow/vendor-protocol-stream-evidence-0828`) as of 2026-08-31, tagged `pr238-freeze-20260831-8d42fe86e` at pin time. PR #238 is still open (not yet merged to main), so `branch` deliberately tracks the PR-head branch rather than `main` per this workflow's own coordinated-cutover mechanism (see cross-repo-integrity.yml's read-pins/pin-freshness comments) — main and this branch are expected to disagree on packages/reference-contract and reference-implementation until #238 merges. Revert `branch` to `main` once #238 lands. Supersedes the prior 5eacd82e pin (main as of 2026-08-20).
